name: Smothering Cookfire Smoke
description: Low cookfire smoke settles under the canopy and shortens sightlines.
counterplay: Gain elevation, move with the wind, or clear the air before committing to a fight.

name: Spore-Choked Rot
description: Rotting fungal blooms kick up throat-catching spores when disturbed.
counterplay: Use masks, fire, or fast movement to keep from lingering in the densest patches.
